//: Build profiles for the GoPasal seller app.
Each profile sets APP_ENV, which app.config.ts turns into the app's name,
its bundle identifier and the API it talks to. That is the whole mechanism:
there is no second place where an environment is decided, so a build cannot
disagree with itself about which API it is for.
Before the first build, run `eas init` in this folder once. It writes the
project id into the config, which is what Expo's push service issues device
tokens against — without it, push registration returns null and the app
runs on without notifications rather than failing.
development  a dev client for a real handset. Talks to the API on the
laptop running Metro, by LAN address worked out at runtime.
preview      an installable APK for testers. Staging API. Side by side with
production, because a tester who must uninstall the real app
to try a candidate will not try it.
